summary:
These relics are not all the same. Some were left with care, because their work was done. Some stopped when dust or winter took away their power. Some are monuments by design, and some became monuments only because distance made retrieval impossible.

We tell their stories in prose because a checklist cannot hold the feeling of a final transmission, an empty landing stage, or a panel that still answers a laser fired from Earth. The facts matter. So does the attention we give them.
details: Abandoned but not Forgotten is a narrative index of human-made objects on the Moon and Mars. It asks readers to look past the triumphant moment of arrival and stay with the quieter part: the equipment, tools, stations, and memorials that remained when the people went home.
dataRefs: Full-scale models of three generations of NASA Mars rovers show the increase in size from the Sojourner rover of the Mars Pathfinder project, to the twin Mars Exploration Rovers Spirit and Opportunity, to the Mars Science Laboratory rover.
